description: List the non-system schemas in a registered foreign Postgres connection. Requires connection_name. System schemas (pg_catalog, information_schema, pg_toast) are excluded.
embedding_description: List the user schemas in a registered external Postgres database, leaving the internal system namespaces out of the result. The top level of foreign-database introspection: start here to see how a database is organised before drilling into a schema's contents.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with a schemas list of user schema names.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: List the schema names (schema metadata, data_sensitivity 0.1). Suggest list_tables with a schema to go deeper.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List the non-system schemas of a registered foreign Postgres connection.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: external_pg.invalid_params: missing connection_name. external_pg.connection_unknown: no connection registered under that name. external_pg.auth_failed / external_pg.permission_denied: the registered credential was rejected. external_pg.platform_db_refused: the connection targets the platform's own database.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: external_pg.connection_unknown: run list_connections. external_pg.auth_failed/permission_denied: ask the operator to re-check the registered connection.
